title: Experiment Room
description: Self-hosted Flagsmith experiments live in Grafana: win probability, lift, traffic split and sample ratio mismatch.

panels.title: Experiments
panels.description: Every experiment in the selected Flagsmith environment (FlagScope data source, read only).

panels.title: Chance to beat control
panels.description: Flagsmith's Bayesian probability that each variant beats control on the experiment metric. Results are refreshed by Flagsmith (at most once per 5 minutes, Grafana Admin only).

panels.title: Results per variant
panels.description: Sample size, conversions, lift versus control and the credible interval, as computed by Flagsmith Experimentation.

panels.title: Conversions per variant (per minute)
panels.description: First conversion per identity, attributed to the variant that identity was first exposed to. Source: Flagsmith SDK events in Postgres. Flag changes from Flagsmith show as annotations.

targets.rawSql:
WITH exp AS (
  SELECT env.api_key, f.name AS feature_name, f.initial_value AS control_value,
         e.feature_id, e.environment_id, e.rollout_segment_id,
         e.id AS experiment_id, e.started_at, e.ended_at
  FROM experimentation_experiment e
  JOIN environments_environment env ON env.id = e.environment_id
  JOIN features_feature f ON f.id = e.feature_id
  WHERE e.id = $experiment
),
metric AS (
  SELECT m.definition ->> 'event' AS event
  FROM experimentation_experimentmetric em
  JOIN experimentation_metric m ON m.id = em.metric_id
  WHERE em.experiment_id = $experiment
  ORDER BY em.id
  LIMIT 1
),
first_exposure AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.identifier) s.identifier, s.value AS variant, s."timestamp" AS exposed_at
  FROM experimentation_sdkexperimentationevent s
  JOIN exp ON s.environment_key = exp.api_key AND s.feature_name = exp.feature_name
  WHERE s.event = chr(36) || 'flag_exposure'
    AND s."timestamp" >= exp.started_at
    AND (exp.ended_at IS NULL OR s."timestamp" <= exp.ended_at)
    AND COALESCE(substring(s.metadata from '"experiment_id" *: *"?([0-9]+)'), exp.experiment_id::text) = exp.experiment_id::text
  ORDER BY s.identifier, s."timestamp"
),
conv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.identifier) s.identifier, s."timestamp" AS converted_at
  FROM experimentation_sdkexperimentationevent s
  JOIN exp ON s.environment_key = exp.api_key
  JOIN metric ON s.event = metric.event
  WHERE true
    AND s."timestamp" >= exp.started_at
    AND (exp.ended_at IS NULL OR s."timestamp" <= exp.ended_at)
  ORDER BY s.identifier, s."timestamp"
)
SELECT date_trunc('minute', c.converted_at) AS time, f.variant AS metric, count(*) AS conversions
FROM conv c
JOIN first_exposure f USING (identifier)
WHERE c.converted_at >= f.exposed_at AND $__timeFilter(c.converted_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Traffic split check (SRM)
panels.description: Chi-square test of the observed exposure split against the allocation configured in Flagsmith, counting only exposures of this experiment since it started. Red means a sample ratio mismatch (p < 0.01 with at least 100 exposures) or any exposure to a variant that is not in the plan: do not trust this experiment until the cause is found.

targets.rawSql:
WITH exp AS (
  SELECT env.api_key, f.name AS feature_name, f.initial_value AS control_value,
         e.feature_id, e.environment_id, e.rollout_segment_id,
         e.id AS experiment_id, e.started_at, e.ended_at
  FROM experimentation_experiment e
  JOIN environments_environment env ON env.id = e.environment_id
  JOIN features_feature f ON f.id = e.feature_id
  WHERE e.id = $experiment
),
alloc AS (
  SELECT mo.string_value AS variant, mv.percentage_allocation::numeric / 100 AS p
  FROM exp e
  JOIN features_featuresegment fsg ON fsg.segment_id = e.rollout_segment_id
       AND fsg.feature_id = e.feature_id AND fsg.environment_id = e.environment_id
  JOIN features_featurestate fs ON fs.feature_segment_id = fsg.id AND fs.deleted_at IS NULL
  JOIN multivariate_multivariatefeaturestatevalue mv ON mv.feature_state_id = fs.id
  JOIN multivariate_multivariatefeatureoption mo ON mo.id = mv.multivariate_feature_option_id
),
expected AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(variant, ''), '(empty)') AS variant, p FROM alloc
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT control_value FROM exp), ''), '(empty)'), 1 - COALESCE(SUM(p), 0) FROM alloc
),
first_exposure AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.identifier) s.identifier, s.value AS variant, s."timestamp" AS exposed_at
  FROM experimentation_sdkexperimentationevent s
  JOIN exp ON s.environment_key = exp.api_key AND s.feature_name = exp.feature_name
  WHERE s.event = chr(36) || 'flag_exposure'
    AND s."timestamp" >= exp.started_at
    AND (exp.ended_at IS NULL OR s."timestamp" <= exp.ended_at)
    AND COALESCE(substring(s.metadata from '"experiment_id" *: *"?([0-9]+)'), exp.experiment_id::text) = exp.experiment_id::text
  ORDER BY s.identifier, s."timestamp"
),
observed AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(variant, ''), '(empty)') AS variant, count(*)::float AS o FROM first_exposure GROUP BY 1),
joined AS (
  SELECT variant, COALESCE(o.o, 0) AS observed, COALESCE(x.p, 0) AS p,
         SUM(COALESCE(o.o, 0)) OVER () * COALESCE(x.p, 0) AS expected,
         SUM(COALESCE(o.o, 0)) OVER () AS total
  FROM expected x FULL JOIN observed o USING (variant)
),
stat AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM((observed - expected) ^ 2 / NULLIF(expected, 0)), 0) AS chi,
         GREATEST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE p > 0) - 1, 0) AS df, max(total) AS total,
         COALESCE(SUM(observed) FILTER (WHERE p = 0), 0) AS unplanned,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM alloc) AS planned_arms
  FROM joined
),
crit AS (
  SELECT chi, df, total, unplanned, planned_arms,
         CASE df WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN 6.635 WHEN 2 THEN 9.210 WHEN 3 THEN 11.345 WHEN 4 THEN 13.277 WHEN 5 THEN 15.086 WHEN 6 THEN 16.812
              ELSE df * (1 - 2.0 / (9 * df) + 2.326 * sqrt(2.0 / (9 * df))) ^ 3 END AS lim
  FROM stat
)
SELECT CASE WHEN planned_arms > 0 THEN round(chi::numeric, 2) END AS chi_square,
       CASE WHEN planned_arms = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN unplanned > 0 THEN 1
            WHEN total >= 100 AND chi > lim THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS srm
FROM crit

panels.title: Observed vs expected exposures
panels.description: chi_square above limit_p01 (critical value for p < 0.01 at this many arms) means the split is off. Expected shares come from the experiment rollout allocation in Flagsmith. A row marked "(not in plan)" is a variant value that the rollout does not allocate; any such exposure turns the SRM check red.
